content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: PhD in Mathematics with a very good publication record; Candidates who have submitted their PhD thesis are also eligible, provided they are suitable for the project Age limit: Maximum 32 years Other conditions: No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview Only shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview Desirable: Very strong background in the analysis of Partial Differential Equations, especially Parabolic and hyperbolic evolution equations. Experience in the analysis of Navier-Stokes equations and related models will get preference.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Initially for seven months (extendable depending on the availability of funds and the performance of the candidate)

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for IIT Indore Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 15 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in IIT Indore Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Research Associate/ Post doctoral fellow.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for IIT Indore Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: By email to [email protected], on or before 15 November 2026. There is no online form.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 32 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Monthly Rs. 62,000 (Consolidated).

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: PhD in Mathematics with a very good publication record.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview. Only shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview.

faq.answer: Shortlisting based on CV and qualifications. Interview of shortlisted candidates. Online interview.

faq.answer: Initially for seven months (extendable depending on the availability of funds and the performance of the candidate).
